caption: Torrazzo of Cremona, Cremona
composition: Torrazzo bell tower beside Cremona Cathedral · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The brick Torrazzo rises at center-left beside the white marble cathedral facade with its great rose window. The round brick baptistery sits to the right of the church, and brick palazzi with arcaded ground floors frame the piazza on both sides. Clear 09:32 morning light warms the stone under a pale blue sky.
